sloka: जानामि त्वां महावीर्यं महोत्साहं महाबलम् ।अपारपारमक्षोभ्यं गाम्भीर्यात् सागरोपमम् ।भर्तारं ससमुद्रायाधरण्या वासवोपमम् ।। ५.३८.४२।।।।
transliteration: jānāmi tvāṁ mahāvīryaṁ mahotsāhaṁ mahābalam ।apārapāramakṣobhyaṁ gāmbhīryāt sāgaropamam ।bhartāraṁ sasamudrāyādharaṇyā vāsavopamam ।। 5.38.42।।।।

translations.english: 'O my supreme lord I know you are kind, righteous, valiant, vigroous, mighty. You are boundless, calm and deep like the ocean. You are lord of earth and the seas and compeer of Vasava. I have heard from you that motiveless compassion is the best way to make one righteous.
